title: AAT Architecten loader
description: A page-load cover: the whole window in the page colour with one small ink dot in the middle. The dot pops in, holds, then shrinks away as the cover fades out after about a second, uncovering the page. Pure CSS.
notes: fixed and full-window: place it once on a page; a fixed header with a higher z-index stays visible above it, as on the original
pure CSS, no JavaScript; not rendered at all under prefers-reduced-motion
name: aat-architecten-loader

props.name: duration
props.description: how long the cover stays before it has fully faded, in seconds
